mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_records (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status_code, check_type, checked_at, gps_latitude, gps_longitude, beacon_uuid, rssi_value, failure_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{statusCode}, #{checkType}, #{checkedAt}, #{gpsLatitude}, #{gpsLongitude}, #{beaconUuid}, #{rssiValue}, #{failureReason}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO attendance_records (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status_code, check_type, failure_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{statusCode}, #{checkType}, #{failureReason}, #{createdBy}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_att_one_day DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: SELECT ar.*, u.name AS student_name, c.class_name AS class_name FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON ar.class_id = c.class_id
mapper.select: WHERE ar.attendance_id = #{attendanceId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON ar.class_id = c.class_id

SELECT beacon_uuid AS beaconUuid, rssi_threshold AS rssiThreshold, gps_latitude AS gpsLatitude, gps_longitude AS gpsLongitude FROM beacons WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY beacon_id LIMIT 1
SELECT s.student_id FROM students s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT u.name FROM students s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className FROM enrollments e JOIN classes c ON e.class_id = c.class_id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.class_id

SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, tu.name AS teacherName, c.classroom AS classroom, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, ar.status_code AS statusCode, ar.checked_at AS checkedAt, ar.check_out_at AS checkOutAt FROM enrollments e JOIN classes c ON e.class_id = c.class_id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON t.user_id = tu.user_id LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON ar.student_id = e.student_id AND ar.class_id = c.class_id AND ar.attendance_date = #{date} WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND (c.days_of_week IS NULL OR c.days_of_week LIKE '%' || #{dayCode} || '%') ORDER BY c.start_time ASC NULLS LAST, c.class_id

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, ar.status_code AS statusCode, ar.checked_at AS checkedAt, ar.check_out_at AS checkOutAt FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON ar.student_id = e.student_id AND ar.class_id = e.class_id AND ar.attendance_date = #{date} WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND (days_of_week IS NULL OR days_of_week LIKE '%' || #{dayCode} || '%')

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName FROM parents p JOIN users pu ON p.user_id = pu.user_id JOIN student_parents sp ON sp.parent_id = p.parent_id JOIN students s ON sp.student_id = s.student_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE pu.login_id = #{loginId} ORDER BY u.name

SELECT c.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className FROM classes c JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} ORDER BY c.class_id
ORDER BY ar.attendance_date DESC, ar.attendance_id DESC
ORDER BY ar.attendance_date DESC, ar.attendance_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON ar.class_id = c.class_id
SELECT MAX(attendance_date) FROM attendance_records
SELECT class_id FROM classes WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time <= #{cutoff} AND (days_of_week IS NULL OR days_of_week LIKE '%' || #{dayCode} || '%')
